tagline.zh: 50 年代课堂片：几何小人、错版印刷的平涂色块，太阳光芒一转，「第 2 步」卡片砸进画面
tagline.en: A 1950s classroom film: geometric presenters and off-register flat colour, and every step slams in on a spinning sunburst
